item.title: Oracle Queries - Get Most Useful Queries 01
item.description:
JustLee Book Database

JustLee Books database ( Oracle Queries ) is a database used by JustLee Books Company. Here are query of JustLee Book Database with tables , relationships between tables and with data to manipulate tables. (only for study purpose).

JustLee Diagram

Oracle Queries - JustLee Book Database Diagram

Tables in JustLee Book

CREATE TABLE Customers
(Customer# NUMBER(4),
LastName VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
FirstName VARCHAR2(10) NOT NULL,
Address VARCHAR2(20),
City VARCHAR2(12),
State VARCHAR2(2),
Zip VARCHAR2(5),
Referred NUMBER(4),
Region CHAR(2),
CONSTRAINT customers_customer#_pk PRIMARY KEY(customer#),
CONSTRAINT customers_region_ck
CHECK (region IN ('N', 'NW', 'NE', 'S', 'SE', 'SW', 'W', 'E')) );

CREATE TABLE ORDERITEMS
( Order# NUMBER(4),

REFERENCES orders (order#) ,
CONSTRAINT orderitems_isbn_fk FOREIGN KEY (isbn)
REFERENCES books (isbn) ,
CONSTRAINT oderitems_quantity_ck CHECK (quantity > 0) );
